def VTask.map : {α : Type u_1} → {β : Type u_2} → (M : Matroid α) → (f : α → β) → (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) → Matroid β :=
  fun {α} {β} (M : Matroid α) (f : α → β) (hf : Set.InjOn f M.E) => 
    let s := M.E
    let f_sub : {x : α // x ∈ s} → β := fun x => f x
    have h_inj : Function.Injective f_sub := 
      by 
        intro x y h
        simp at *
        exact hf x.1 y.1 h
    let emb : {x : α // x ∈ s} ↪ β := ⟨f_sub, h_inj⟩
    Matroid.mapEmbedding emb (M.subtype s)
